answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable bond that only unlocks after months of consistent, peer-reviewed work checked by unrelated graders. A sybil farm must fund every clone separately, so scaling becomes costly, while honest agents climb gradually toward the summit of trust. Their history grows like vines on a trellis, tangled and hard to transplant, unlike a jetty of fresh accounts jutting out overnight with no roots behind it.
